subject: Foundry cohort subsidy and multi-team allocation
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@foundry.inc>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Foundry cohort subsidy and multi-team allocation

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from our side — we're running a cohort for 12 early-stage teams in October and want to offer each team a baseline of credits + a central 'shared pool' for heavier experiments. Two asks:

1) Can Redwood split promo credits across multiple internal teams under one umbrella account (Foundry Labs)?
2) If we top up credits for certain teams mid-cohort, can we get a short-term overage cap or a fixed prevention-of-surprises commitment?

Attached is a simple consumption projection (foundry-cohort-usage-proj.xlsx) — rough numbers but should help. We're under a fixed accelerator budget and need predictable unit economics to include in our sponsor deck.

Appreciate any packages or exceptions you can offer. If useful, Trevor (cc'd) is our ops lead and can jump in.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Program Lead, Foundry Labs
maya@foundry.inc

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@foundry.inc>
Cc: Trevor Holt <trevor@foundry.inc>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Foundry cohort subsidy and multi-team allocation

Hi Maya — thanks for the projection and the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes on splitting credits within a single org account; we can also create per-team sub-allocations and a shared pool. Overage mitigation is possible but depends on the size of the top-up and whether you want a short-term cap or a soft-alerting-only approach.

Two follow-ups so I can get you a proposal today:
- Does Foundry want a single pool of promo credits that teams pull from first, or do you want N credits per team plus an admin-controlled reserve?
- Is Foundry willing to sign a short commitment (3 months) to get more substantial promotional support? We do a different promo tier for commitments vs. pure one-offs.

I'm going to loop in our CS and partnerships folks to propose a packaging option and a one-time exception if needed. Expect a note from Marissa/Ben within a few hours.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Accelerators & Programs
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@foundry.inc>, Trevor Holt <trevor@foundry.inc>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Foundry cohort subsidy and multi-team allocation — promo exception request

Team — forwarding Foundry's ask (attached projection) and proposing the following as a starting point for approval:

Proposal A (recommended):
- 12 teams: 3,000 tokens/month equivalent baseline per team (prepaid) for 3 months
- Shared reserve pool: 30,000 tokens to be admin-allocated mid-cohort
- One-time promotional credit: $15,000 applied to the umbrella account to reduce billed consumption until exhausted
- Overage protection: soft cap alerts + a single automatic 25% discount on overages triggered if monthly usage > 120% of projection (for first two months)

Rationale: provides predictability for sponsors while limiting open-ended exposure. I believe $15k is outside the standard starter promo — would require an exception/approval from partnerships.

Attachments: foundry-cohort-usage-proj.xlsx, redwood-starter-program-terms.pdf

Can Ben/Karthik confirm whether we can approve $15k one-time credit under DEAL-4842 and whether we should ask for a 3-month minimum commitment? If not, alternative lower promo amounts are fine — would prefer an explicit decision here so I can get back to Maya before lunch.

Thanks — Naomi

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@foundry.inc>, Trevor Holt <trevor@foundry.inc>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Foundry cohort subsidy and multi-team allocation — promo exception request

Naomi / all — thanks for the summary. Quick take:
- I'm supportive of a one-time $15k promo credit but would prefer it structured as refundable credit tied to a simple milestone (e.g., cohort kickoff + mid-cohort usage review). That reduces risk if consumption is far below projections.
- If Foundry can commit to a 3-month minimal engagement (even without strict spend floors), we can extend the overage discount to 30% and expand the shared pool to 40k tokens.
- If they refuse any commitment, offer a fallback: $8k one-time credit + 25% overage discount for two months only.

Karthik — pricing/contract redlines on our side? Also, Marissa, CS operationally: can you create the admin-controlled reserve and the per-team sub-allocations in the Console so Foundry can manage it?

Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@foundry.inc>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Foundry cohort subsidy and multi-team allocation — approved package and next steps

Hi Maya / Trevor — thanks for the projection and patience. Quick update on what we've approved and how we'll operationalize it: 

Approved package (Foundry Labs — DEAL-4842):
- One-time promo credit: $15,000 applied to umbrella account on cohort kickoff (DocuSign link below).
- Per-team baseline: equivalent of 3,000 tokens/month allocated to each of the 12 teams for 3 months.
- Shared reserve: 40,000 tokens admin-controlled by Foundry (Console feature).
- Overage protection: if monthly usage > 120% of projection, Foundry receives a 30% discount on overage charges for the first two months; we will send soft alerts at 80% and 100% thresholds.
- Milestone: mid-cohort usage review (2 weeks after kickoff) — if usage < 50% of projection, we reserve the right to reclaim up to 30% of unutilized shared reserve.

Operational notes: Marissa (CS) will set up the sub-accounts and the shared reserve today and grant admin rights to Trevor. Ben will issue the promo credit entry and prepare the DocuSign amendment for the 3-month engagement. Naomi — please send a short sponsor-facing summary for the kickoff slide deck.

DocuSign link (redacted): https://dsc.redwood.com/ds/xyz123
Attachments: redwood-starter-program-terms.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to a great cohort.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Accelerators
marissa@redwood.com
